sentences.zh: 2月10日晚眼看又是一个平静的夜晚，直到他接到弗雷德·梅迪尔的电话，表达了他对女儿阿比娜的担忧。

sentences.en: Constable Eyre and his partner, Constable John Quirk, arrived at the Medill house to get the particulars, then headed out to check popular haunts to see if Abina was at any.
sentences.zh: 艾尔警员和他的搭档约翰·奎克警员来到梅迪尔家了解详情，然后前往检查热门去处，看阿比娜是否在其中某个地方。

sentences.en: After a fruitless search, the policeman returned to the Medill house, where her family had since learned that Abina was in the company of Gary
sentences.zh: 经过一番毫无结果的搜寻后，警察回到了梅迪尔家，此时她的家人已经得知阿比娜与加里在一起

sentences.en: Haywood.

sentences.zh: 警察开车前往海伍德的住所，将情况通知了加里的父亲查理。

sentences.en: The bedroom Gary shared with his younger brother was checked, but his bed was empty.
sentences.zh: 加里和弟弟共用的卧室被检查过了，但他的床是空的。

sentences.en: Charlie and Alan Haywood joined Fred Medill and the constables in searching for the young pair, checking cars parked outside motels and other locations they thought the teenagers
sentences.zh: 查理和艾伦·海伍德与弗雷德·梅迪尔及警员们一起寻找这一对年轻人，检查停在汽车旅馆外以及他们认为青少年

sentences.en: might be.

sentences.en: They found no sign of them, and by 3am, Fred Medill headed back to the police station to formally report his daughter as missing.
sentences.zh: 他们没有发现他们的踪迹，到凌晨3点，弗雷德·梅迪尔返回警察局，正式报告女儿失踪。

sentences.en: The link between Gary and Abina puzzled both families.
sentences.zh: 加里和阿比娜之间的联系让两个家庭都感到困惑。

sentences.en: Although Gary had worked with and befriended Abina, he never mentioned her to his father, nor had Abina spoken of Gary to her family.
sentences.zh: 尽管加里曾与阿比娜共事并成为朋友，但他从未向父亲提起过她，阿比娜也从未向家人提起过加里。

sentences.en: Charlie returned home and started contacting his son's friends to see whether they could shed more light on the night's events.
sentences.zh: 查理回到家，开始联系他儿子的朋友们，想看看他们能否提供更多关于当晚事件的线索。

sentences.en: Witness reports revealed that as Abina sat in his car at the Civic Centre, Gary asked his friends
sentences.zh: 目击者报告显示，当阿比娜坐在他位于市民中心的车里时，加里要求他的朋友们

sentences.en: to get out so he could drive her back to the lake and park by the banks of the Goulburn River, the spot known locally as a lover's lane.
sentences.zh: 下车，以便他能开车送她回到湖边，并将车停在戈尔本河畔——当地人称为情人巷的地方。

sentences.en: Gary promised his friends he would return later to take them home and gave them a set of his keys and Abina's wristwatch as a guarantee of their intention to return.
sentences.zh: 加里向朋友们承诺他稍后会回来接他们回家，并交出了他的一把钥匙和阿比娜的手表作为他们会回来的保证。

sentences.en: The pair were last seen driving off together in Gary's FJ Holden.
sentences.zh: 两人最后一次被目击是一起开着加里的FJ霍顿汽车离开。

sentences.en: Gary kept his word, returning to the Civic Centre within half an hour, but his friends had since departed.
sentences.zh: 加里信守承诺，在半小时内回到了市民中心，但他的朋友们此时已经离开了。

sentences.en: When the concert ended shortly before 11.30pm, a witness saw Gary drive past the centre, but didn't notice if there was anyone else in the car.
sentences.zh: 当音乐会在晚上11点30分前不久结束时，一名目击者看到加里开车驶过中心，但没有注意到车里是否还有其他人。

sentences.en: Constable's air and
sentences.zh: 康斯特布尔的空气和

sentences.zh: 奎克搜寻了数小时，却毫无结果。

sentences.en: They suspected the teenagers had spent the night together and there was no cause for alarm.
sentences.zh: 他们怀疑这两个年轻人在一起过夜了，因此无需惊慌。

sentences.en: Constable Quirk's shift ended at 5am, so Constable Eyre gave him a lift home before returning to the police station.
sentences.zh: 奎克警员的班次在凌晨5点结束，于是埃尔警员顺便载他回家，然后返回了警察局。

sentences.en: As he drove back towards town, he sighted Gary's green FJ Holden parked haphazardly in Wyndham

sentences.en: Charlie Haywood knew his son loved the car and would never abandon it in such a careless manner.
sentences.zh: 查理·海伍德知道他的儿子很爱这辆车，绝不会以这种漫不经心的方式抛弃它。

sentences.en: The discovery of Gary's vehicle sparked a widespread police search, one of the largest in Victoria at the time.
sentences.zh: 加里座驾的发现引发了大规模的警方搜查，这也是维多利亚州当时规模最大的搜查之一。

sentences.en: They were assisted by the missing teen's families, with the Haywoods even taking their pet terrier along to see if she could detect Gary's scent.
sentences.zh: 失踪少年的家属也协助了搜查，海伍德一家甚至带上了他们的宠物梗犬，看看它能不能闻到加里的气味。

sentences.en: Friends, locals and out-of-towners alike volunteered as well.
sentences.zh: 无论是朋友、当地居民还是外地游客也都纷纷参与了志愿活动。

sentences.en: Some speculated the couple had run off together, but those who knew them didn't believe this to be the case, describing Gary and Abina as casual acquaintances.
sentences.zh: 有人推测这对男女一起私奔了，但熟悉他们的人并不相信这种说法，他们将加里和阿比娜描述为泛泛之交。

sentences.en: Both were well known and highly regarded in Shepparton, and neither had expressed a wants or need to leave.

sentences.zh: 车被找到后，海伍德一家把它开回家，停在了前院的草坪上。

sentences.en: Later that morning,
sentences.zh: 那天早上晚些时候，

sentences.en: Realising his son's actions could destroy valuable evidence,
sentences.zh: 意识到儿子的行为可能会破坏有价值的证据，

sentences.zh: 查理迅速制止了艾伦，没有让他继续下去。

sentences.en: Ex-Homicide Squad detective Peter Parkinson was considered Shepparton's toughest cop.
sentences.zh: 前凶杀案调查组警探彼得·帕金森被认为是谢珀顿最硬气的警察。

sentences.en: He took charge of the investigation into the disappearance of Abina Medill and Gary Haywood.
sentences.zh: 他负责调查阿比娜·麦迪尔和加里·海伍德失踪案。

sentences.en: Described as old school, aggressive, and at times excessive, Detective Parkinson was results-driven and uncompromising in his job.
sentences.zh: 帕金森警探被形容为老派、好斗，有时甚至过激，他办案注重结果且态度强硬。

sentences.en: He was already familiar with Gary Haywood and knew how much he loved his car, as he lived around the corner from the family and regularly saw the young man
sentences.zh: 他已经认识加里·海伍德，并且知道他有多爱他的车，因为他就住在海伍德家拐角处，经常看到这个年轻人在

sentences.en: washing it when he passed by.
sentences.zh: 路过时洗车。

sentences.en: Mindful that Gary would never ditch the Holden by choice, one of Detective Parkinson's first actions was to seize the vehicle and examine it for evidence.
sentences.zh: 考虑到加里绝不会自愿丢弃这辆霍顿汽车，帕金森警探采取的首要行动之一就是扣押该车并检查证据。

sentences.en: Two unidentified fingerprints pointing downward were detected on top of the driver's side door.
sentences.zh: 在驾驶员一侧车门上方检测到两个朝下的未识别指纹。

sentences.zh: 位于谢珀顿以南，紧邻古尔本谷公路。

sentences.zh: 他在下方干燥的河床里发现了一个女式白色皮质单肩包，并把它交到了当地警察局。

sentences.en: It contained a one-pound note, some change, a powder compact, key case, a handkerchief and tissues as well as a metal disc engraved with the word Billy.
sentences.zh: 里面有一张一镑纸币、一些零钱、一个粉盒、一个钥匙包、一块手帕和纸巾，还有一个刻有“比利”字样的金属牌。

sentences.en: The name Abina Medill was printed on the bag's inside lining alongside her Maxwell Street address.
sentences.zh: 包的内衬上印着阿比娜·梅迪尔的名字以及她位于麦克斯韦街的地址。

sentences.en: Given this spotlighted Gary as a possible suspect, three detectives aggressively grilled his father Charlie, trying to find out whether he was concealing his son from authorities.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这把加里置于嫌疑人的聚光灯下，三名侦探气势汹汹地盘问他的父亲查理，试图弄清他是否在包庇儿子、隐瞒当局。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the Haywoods' home was undergoing a thorough search.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，海伍德的家正在接受彻底搜查。

sentences.en: Police also questioned Gary's girlfriend, Gail, but she could offer nothing of value.
sentences.zh: 警方还讯问了加里的女朋友盖尔，但她提供不出任何有价值的信息。

sentences.en: By Monday February 14, additional police resources arrived from Melbourne, including a search and rescue team, police divers, and a light aircraft.
sentences.zh: 到2月14日星期一，更多的警力从墨尔本赶来，包括搜救队、水警潜水员和一架轻型飞机。

sentences.en: More than 100 volunteers were now involved in the efforts to find the pair, including all the employees of the Haywoods panel beaters.
sentences.zh: 现在有100多名志愿者参与了寻找两人的行动，其中包括海伍德钣金厂的所有员工。

sentences.en: Although no bodies had been located, Melbourne's homicide squad also arrived in Shepparton to assist in the investigation.
sentences.zh: 尽管尚未找到尸体，墨尔本凶杀案调查组也抵达谢珀顿协助调查。

sentences.en: By now, the story had reached the front page of the Shepparton News and was even making headlines in Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 此时，这个故事已经登上了《谢珀顿新闻》的头版，甚至成了墨尔本各大报纸的头条。

sentences.en: Rumours spread that a fight at the Mod Spectacular might have something to do with Gary and Abena's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 有传言称，“摩尔狂欢节”上的一场打斗可能与加里和阿比娜的失踪有关。

sentences.en: Police appealed for a group of
sentences.zh: 警方呼吁一群

sentences.en: Melbourne rock and roll fans who had attended the show to come forward, but the lead went nowhere.
sentences.zh: 曾参加过该演出的墨尔本摇滚乐迷站出来提供线索，但这条线索最终不了了之。

sentences.en: On the sixth day of the search, the questioning of a local 16-year-old led detectives to the suburban strip of St Andrews Road, where they found an undergarment under a rock.
sentences.zh: 在搜寻的第六天，对当地一名16岁少年的讯问将侦探们引向了圣安德鲁路的郊区地段，他们在那里的一块岩石下发现了一件内衣。

sentences.en: It was initially believed to have belonged to a beaner, but this was later disproved.
sentences.zh: 最初人们认为它属于阿比娜，但后来被证实并非如此。

sentences.en: After further questioning, the youth was released.
sentences.zh: 经过进一步讯问，该名青年被释放。

sentences.en: Although police had been able to quickly determine that the underwear did not belong to Abena, the story still went public, causing great pain to her family.
sentences.zh: 尽管警方很快确定这件内衣不属于阿比娜，但此事还是被公之于众，给她的家人带来了巨大的痛苦。

sentences.en: The search continued for another two days, extending to the rough country along the Goulburn River and into the thick bushland around Shepparton.
sentences.zh: 搜寻工作又持续了两天，范围扩大到古尔本河沿岸崎岖的乡村以及谢珀顿周围茂密的灌木林。

sentences.zh: 州森林局的雇员骑着马出发，固定翼飞机在空中搜寻，水警潜水员则潜入了该地区大大小小的水潭中。

sentences.zh: 他们的搜寻工作受到了该地区大量蛇类的阻碍，搜寻人员曾在一天内打死了13条蛇。

sentences.zh: 2月19日星期六，距离两名青少年失踪已经过去九天。

sentences.en: These supposed sightings gave the Medill and Haywood families hope that their children were still alive.

sentences.en: His jumper was discovered near the stockings and in addition to being covered in grass seeds, leaves and bark, there were traces of blood on it.
sentences.zh: 他的套头衫在长筒袜附近被发现，上面除了沾满草籽、树叶和树皮外，还有血迹痕迹。

sentences.en: Abena's skirt and girdle were found neatly folded nearby, with one white shoe next to the pile and one on top.
sentences.zh: 阿比娜的裙子和束腰带被整齐地折叠在附近，一只白鞋放在衣物堆旁，另一只放在上面。

sentences.en: There was also a second fired 22 calibre cartridge case, indicating that the killer may have shot at Gary twice but only hit him once,
sentences.zh: 现场还发现了第二枚击发过的.22口径弹壳，这表明凶手可能向加里开枪两次，但只击中了他一次，

sentences.zh: 以及一小块黑色塑料，侦探们认为这可能是凶器的一部分。

sentences.en: The keys to Gary's Holden were not at the scene, nor was the rug he kept in the car, and his upper dentures were also missing.
sentences.zh: 加里的霍顿汽车钥匙不在现场，他放在车里的地毯也不见了，他的上排假牙也失踪了。

sentences.en: Investigators ascertained that the assailant had abducted the pair at gunpoint near Victoria Lake.
sentences.zh: 调查人员确认为凶手在维多利亚湖附近持枪劫持了两人。

sentences.en: Dust on Gary's car matched samples taken from the paddock, meaning the killer had driven or ordered the teens to drive to the area where their bodies were later found.
sentences.zh: 加里汽车上的灰尘与从牧场提取的样本相吻合，这意味着凶手曾开车或命令青少年开车前往后来发现他们尸体的地方。

sentences.en: It appeared as though Gary struggled with his captor before either running off into the thicket of trees or was marched there before being tied up and executed.
sentences.zh: 看起来加里曾在与绑架者搏斗，随后要么跑进树丛，要么被押解到那里，然后被捆绑并处决。

sentences.en: The perpetrator then returned to a beaner who was either restrained or unconscious and proceeded to rape her before bludgeoning her to death.
sentences.zh: 随后凶手返回到受到束缚或失去知觉的阿比娜身旁，对其实施了强奸，并将其殴打致死。

sentences.en: The careless way in which Gary's car was left back in Shepparton suggested the killer had

sentences.en: Investigating police described the murders as beyond comprehension and the most brutal killing they had ever encountered.

sentences.en: The families of the two victims were extremely distraught.
sentences.zh: 两名死者的家属悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: Gary Haywood's mother, Margaret, lost a great deal of weight and struggled to maintain the will to live.
sentences.zh: 加里·海伍德的母亲玛格丽特体重锐减，苦苦挣扎着维持生存的意志。

sentences.en: His brother Alan was left terrified, thinking the killer would come after him next.
sentences.zh: 他的兄弟阿兰吓坏了，认为凶手下一个就会来找他。

sentences.en: Abina Medill's father expressed his shock at her murder in his formal police statement, writing, I cannot think of any reason why any person would want to harm my daughter.
sentences.zh: 阿比娜·梅迪尔的父亲在正式警方笔录中表达了他对女儿遇害的震惊，写道：“我想不出任何人要伤害我女儿的任何理由。”

sentences.en: An extra team of detectives arrived in Shepparton as officers worked upwards of 16 hours a day to hunt down those responsible.
sentences.zh: 又有一队侦探抵达谢珀顿，警员们每天工作16小时以上以追捕凶手。

sentences.en: The double homicide had left the small and otherwise quiet city reeling and pressure to find the culprits was intense.
sentences.zh: 这起双重凶杀案让这个原本平静的小城市陷入震惊，破案的压力巨大。

sentences.en: A $10,000 reward for information was on offer and a rug matching the one that was missing from Gary's car was displayed in the window of a major store in the middle of town.
sentences.zh: 悬赏1万元征集线索，一条与加里车中失踪地毯相仿的地毯被展示在镇中心一家大型商店的橱窗里。

sentences.en: One individual came to police attention after a matching rug was spotted in his home.
sentences.zh: 一名男子在自己家中被发现挂着一条相似的地毯，从而引起了警方的注意。

sentences.en: The man, Ian Stanley Loffel, was in his late 30s and told police he had stolen the rug from a dark blue Holden with South Australian registration plates
sentences.zh: 这名男子名叫伊恩·斯坦利·洛弗尔，30多岁，他告诉警方，他从一辆停在谢珀顿以西6公里的小镇马鲁特纳一家酒吧外的深蓝色霍顿汽车上偷了这条地毯，

sentences.en: parked outside a pub in Marootna, a town 6km west of Shepparton.
sentences.zh: 该车挂有南澳大利亚州车牌。

sentences.en: Police spoke with local mechanics to see if they'd seen any vehicles similar to the one Loffel described and found a match.
sentences.zh: 警方走访了当地机械师，看他们是否见过类似于洛弗尔所描述的车辆，并找到了符合特征的车。

sentences.en: Convinced this was a promising lead, police tracked the vehicle down to a car yard in South Australia, only to find its drivers had airtight alibis for the night of February 10.
sentences.zh: 确信这是一条有希望的线索后，警方在南澳大利亚州的一个汽车场追踪到了这辆车，结果发现驾驶员在2月10日晚上有无可辩驳的不在场证明。

sentences.en: Police suspected two or more people had committed the crimes.
sentences.zh: 警方怀疑这起犯罪是两人或多人所为。

sentences.en: The region's fruit-picking season was at its peak and they considered the possibility that the murderers could be among the thousands
sentences.zh: 该地区的果园采摘季正值高峰，他们认为凶手可能混迹于为了临时打零工而来到镇上的数千名

sentences.en: of workers temporarily in town for casual employment.
sentences.zh: 工人之中。

sentences.en: When investigators asked local orchardists to report any suspicious workers, hundreds of tip-offs came in, but none led anywhere.
sentences.zh: 当调查人员要求当地果农报告任何可疑工人时，收到了数百条线索，但没有一条指向实质结果。

sentences.en: As such, police were inclined to believe the murders were committed by locals, as the remoteness of the crime scene indicated the killers were familiar with the area.
sentences.zh: 因此，警方倾向于认为谋杀案是当地人所为，因为案发现场的偏僻表明凶手对该地区非常熟悉。

sentences.en: They were soon concentrating on the town's teenagers in particular.
sentences.zh: 他们很快将注意力集中在镇上的青少年身上。

sentences.en: There were reports of a party hurled near the Goulburn River, close to the west side of Victoria
sentences.zh: 据报道，在谋杀案当晚，维多利亚湖西侧附近的古尔本河畔曾举行过一场聚会。

sentences.en: Lake, on the night of the murders.
sentences.zh: 活动包含一场赛车，并在其中一辆车撞上另一辆车后，演变成了一场参会者之间的激烈群殴。

sentences.en: It involved a car race and ended in a fierce brawl between attendees when one vehicle hit another.
sentences.zh: 警方认为加里当时可能在场并参与了这场群殴，随后被对手出于报复而杀害。

sentences.zh: 一位高级侦探对媒体表示：

sentences.zh: 由于得知阿比娜与加里·海伍德离开后大发醋劲，并为此威胁要杀掉加里，他被视为主要嫌疑人。

sentences.en: He was viewed as a prime suspect due to his jealous outburst after learning Abina had left with Gary Haywood, whom he then threatened to kill over the matter.

sentences.en: At the time, the Melbourne Homicide Squad had a reputation for being hard officers who were tough on criminals, often beating a confession out of a suspect if necessary.
sentences.zh: 伊恩定期被传唤到警察局接受正式讯问，期间遭到侦探们的辱骂、耳光和踢打。

sentences.en: Ian was regularly summoned to the station for formal police interviews, during which he was verbally abused, slapped and kicked by detectives.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他是受到朋友兼室友彼得·黑泽尔曼的协助，后者在谋杀案当晚开车搭载了他。

sentences.en: They believed he was assisted by his friend and housemate Peter Hazelman who drove him around on the night of the murders.
sentences.zh: 彼得也受到了警察的讯问和粗暴对待，他们的好几个朋友亦是如此。

sentences.en: Peter was also questioned and subjected to aggressive treatment at the hands of the police, as were several of their other friends.
sentences.zh: 尽管手段严厉，伊恩并未承认参与犯罪。

sentences.en: Despite these heavy-handed tactics, Ian did not admit any involvement in the crime.
sentences.zh: 侦探们推测他骨头太硬难以攻克，其中一人对一名穿制服的警官说，引述：“狠狠地拷打和殴打过厄克特，但他就是不肯招认。”

sentences.en: Detectives presumed he was too tough to crack, with one remarking to a uniformed officer that he had, quote, belted and belted Urquhart, but he will not confess.
sentences.zh: 当伊恩的姐姐海瑟注意到他如此痛苦时，她询问警察讯问的内容，但他似乎感到羞耻而拒绝回答。

sentences.en: When Ian's older sister Heather noticed how miserable he was, she asked what the police interviews involved, but he seemed ashamed and refused to answer.
sentences.zh: 伊恩向朋友吐露，他非常害怕警察以及自己可能会遭遇的下场。

sentences.en: Ian confided in friends that he was very scared of the police and what might happen to him.
sentences.zh: 他开始向父亲或朋友借车在野外露营，而不是回家，以免警察找到他。

sentences.en: He began borrowing a car from his father or a friend in order to camp out instead of returning home where officers could find him.

sentences.en: hurting him, even though Victorian laws at the time meant a confession would have most likely resulted in his execution.

sentences.en: Heather convinced him not to confess.

sentences.zh: 有史以来规模最大的追悼会。

sentences.en: Shepparton had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 加里的葬礼于下午1点在圣布兰登天主教堂举行，两小时后阿比娜的葬礼在斯科特长老会教堂举行。

sentences.en: Gary's was held at St Brendan's Catholic Church at 1pm, while Abina's was at Scott's Presbyterian Church two hours later.
sentences.zh: 全城陷入停顿，商店关门歇业，人们聚集在一起观看送葬队伍经过。

sentences.zh: 两座教堂都挤满了人，哀悼者溢出到街道上。

sentences.en: Both churches were filled to capacity, with mourners spilling out onto the streets.
sentences.zh: 在阿比娜的葬礼期间，悲痛欲绝的伊恩·厄克特被发现在姐姐海瑟的陪同下站在教堂后方。

sentences.en: Two detectives visited the home of his sister Heather to inform the family and reluctantly acknowledged that their questioning of Ian had been particularly tough
sentences.zh: 尽管伊恩被洗清了嫌疑，但媒体、社区和一些警员仍然认为他有罪。

sentences.en: due to the seriousness of the case.

sentences.en: Despite Ian being cleared, the media, community and some police members still believed him to be guilty.

sentences.zh: 加里·海伍德和阿比娜·梅迪尔未破谋杀案的死因研讯于1970年6月举行，距离这两名青少年的尸体被发现已有四年之久。

sentences.en: It had been postponed by the case investigators, and when asked why,

sentences.zh: 高级警员彼得·帕金森解释道，

sentences.en: By this stage, inquiries had been made across the country, in Queensland, New South Wales and South Australia, as well as overseas in the United States.

sentences.en: Accepting the breakthrough they were hoping for remained out of reach, the inquest into the double homicide was finally scheduled to commence on Tuesday June 9.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们所期盼的突破仍然遥不可及，这起双重凶杀案的死因研讯最终还是定于6月9日星期二开始。

sentences.en: Frank Medill spoke at the inquest, describing his daughter as a normal girl of her years who followed the modern teenage trend.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·梅迪尔在听证会上发言，形容他的女儿是一个像她这个年纪的正常女孩，紧跟现代青少年的潮流。

sentences.en: He couldn't think of a reason why anybody would want to harm her.
sentences.zh: 他想不出任何人会想要伤害她的理由。

sentences.en: Charlie Haywood described his son as a regular boy who respected his parents and always did as he was asked.
sentences.zh: 查理·海伍德形容他的儿子是一个正常的男孩，尊敬父母，并且总是听从吩咐。

sentences.en: When called to the stand, Senior Constable Peter Parkinson told the coroner that 3,478 individuals had been interviewed and investigations were still ongoing.
sentences.zh: 当被传唤出庭时，高级警员彼得·帕金森告诉验尸官，已有3,478人接受了讯问，调查仍在进行中。

sentences.en: After hearing evidence from 16 witnesses, the coroner was unable to offer new evidence or

sentences.zh: 见解，并宣布加里和阿比娜于1966年2月11日凌晨被一个或多个未知身份的人杀害。

sentences.en: very annoyed upon learning Abina had gone driving with Gary.
sentences.zh: “得知阿比娜和加里开车出去后非常生气。”

sentences.en: Ian was living in Singapore at the time of the inquest and was not called to give evidence.
sentences.zh: 听证会期间，伊恩正住在新加坡，并未被传唤出庭作证。

sentences.en: He had built a new life for himself overseas, earning good money working as a maintenance specialist on offshore drilling rigs.
sentences.zh: 他在海外建立了自己的新生活，作为海上钻井平台的维修专家赚取了丰厚的收入。

sentences.en: Two years later, on Friday February 11, 1972, almost six years to the day since his girlfriend was murdered, Ian Urquhart and a colleague
sentences.zh: 两年后的1972年2月11日星期五，距离他的女友被害几乎整整六年，伊恩·厄克特和一位同事

sentences.en: returned to Singapore following a work trip to Sumatra.
sentences.zh: 在结束了对苏门答腊的工作旅行后返回新加坡。

sentences.en: They disembarked their flight shortly after midnight and left the airport in Ian's vehicle, a cream-coloured MG sports car.
sentences.zh: 他们在午夜后不久走下飞机，并驾驶伊恩的座驾——一辆奶油色的MG跑车离开机场。

sentences.en: While driving down a highway, Ian crashed the vehicle at high speed, killing both himself and his passenger instantly.
sentences.zh: 在公路上行驶时，伊恩驾车高速撞毁，导致他本人和乘客当场身亡。

sentences.zh: 他的葬礼在斯科特长老

sentences.en: Located nearly 200 kilometres south of Shepparton is the Melbourne suburb of Donvale.
sentences.zh: 位于谢珀顿以南近200公里处是墨尔本的唐维尔郊区。

sentences.en: In the 1960s, Donvale was characterised by dense bushland, farms and orchards, but by the early 70s the area was changing, with clusters of residential homes cropping up in place
sentences.zh: 在20世纪60年代，唐维尔的特点是茂密的灌木林、农场和果园，但到了70年代初，该地区正在发生变化，大片农村土地上

sentences.en: of the large blocks of rural land.
sentences.zh: 涌现出了一群群住宅。

sentences.en: On the evening of Monday July 26 1971, 25-year-old Suzanne was at her Donvale home with her three children while her husband was out visiting friends.
sentences.zh: 1971年7月26日星期一晚上，25岁的苏珊娜和她的三个孩子呆在唐维尔的家中，而她的丈夫则外出拜访朋友。

sentences.en: After putting the children to bed, Suzanne decided to mop the kitchen floor and at around
sentences.zh: 把孩子哄上床睡觉后，苏珊娜决定拖洗厨房的地板，大约在

sentences.en: 10pm she went to fetch some clean water from the laundry.
sentences.zh: 晚上10点，她去洗衣房取一些清水。

sentences.en: When she entered the hallway, she was confronted by a man she initially took to be her husband, until she noticed his face was covered in a mask made from a stocking.
sentences.zh: 当她走进走廊时，迎面遇到一个男子，她最初以为是她的丈夫，直到她注意到他的脸被丝袜做成的面具遮住。

sentences.en: He raised his right hand, which held a long butcher's knife, causing Suzanne to scream.
sentences.zh: 他举起右手，手里握着一把长切肉刀，这让苏珊娜尖叫起来。

sentences.en: The masked intruder told her to keep quiet and explained that he didn't want to hurt her, before backing her into the kitchen and demanding money.
sentences.zh: 戴面具的入侵者让她保持安静，并解释说他不想伤害她，随后将她逼回厨房并索要钱财。

sentences.en: He then ordered her to undress.
sentences.zh: 接着他命令她脱衣服。

sentences.en: Anticipating what would happen next, Suzanne disclosed that she had recently given birth and still had stitches.
sentences.zh: 预感到接下来会发生什么，苏珊透露自己最近刚生过孩子，身上还有缝合的伤口。

sentences.en: The assailant replied that he was just going to tie up her hands and feet, then leave, and ordered her to sit on the floor.
sentences.zh: 袭击者回答说，他只是想把她的手脚绑起来就离开，并命令她坐在地板上。

sentences.en: After he finished restraining Suzanne's hands behind her back with a stocking, he tied her ankles together, then began rubbing her breasts.
sentences.zh: 用长筒袜将苏珊的双手反绑在身后後，他绑住了她的脚踝，然后开始揉捏她的胸部。

sentences.en: She screamed loudly and the man fled.
sentences.zh: 她大声尖叫，男子随即逃跑。

sentences.en: Suzanne managed to untie herself and immediately phoned the police.
sentences.zh: 苏珊设法解开了绳子，并立即报警。

sentences.en: Two detectives arrived within minutes and soon realised that the assault shared a number of similarities with a rape committed in Donvale 11 days earlier.
sentences.zh: 两名侦探在几分钟内赶到，很快意识到这起袭击与11天前在唐维尔发生的一起强奸案有许多相似之处。

sentences.en: The suburb of Greensboro lies roughly 17 kilometres northwest of Donvale.
sentences.zh: 格林斯伯勒郊区位于唐维尔西北约17公里处。

sentences.en: Four years after the attack on Suzanne, 23-year-old
sentences.zh: 在袭击苏珊事件发生的四年后，23岁的

sentences.en: Cathy was spending the night of Friday January 31 1975 in her Greensboro home with her two children while her fiancé was away interstate.
sentences.zh: 凯西在1975年1月31日星期五的夜晚，独自带着两个孩子待在格林斯伯勒的家中，当时她的未婚夫去外州了。

sentences.en: Kathy and her son were both sleeping in her bed while her infant daughter slept in a cot in the nursery.
sentences.zh: 凯西和她的儿子一起睡在她的床上，而她襁褓中的女儿则睡在婴儿房的婴儿床里。

sentences.en: At approximately 4.10 in the morning,
sentences.zh: 大约凌晨4点10分，

sentences.en: Kathy was woken by a noise she thought was her daughter rattling the side of her cot.
sentences.zh: 凯西被一阵声音吵醒，她以为是女儿在摇晃婴儿床的栏杆。

sentences.en: She listened quietly for several minutes before hearing the sound again from the direction of the laundry.
sentences.zh: 她静静地听了几分钟，然后又从洗衣房的方向听到了这个声音。

sentences.en: She switched on her bedroom light and saw a man standing in the doorway of the bathroom, brandishing a 12-inch knife up high in his right hand.
sentences.zh: 她打开卧室的灯，看到一个男子站在浴室门口，右手高高挥舞着一把12英寸长的刀。

sentences.en: Cathy screamed, then told the intruder that a friend was staying over in the guest room and had likely heard her and called the police.
sentences.zh: 凯西尖叫起来，随后告诉入侵者，有一个朋友住在客房里，可能已经听到她的声音并报了警。

sentences.en: The man responded, it's a lie, no one will see you for a couple of days until your husband gets back.
sentences.zh: 这名男子回答说，这是谎言，在你的丈夫回来之前，没人会看到你的。

sentences.en: He forced her back to her bed, placed a blanket over her terrified son and raped her.
sentences.zh: 他强行将她推回床上，用毯子盖住她吓坏了的儿子并强暴了她。

sentences.en: Police collected small amounts of evidence from the scene, including the perpetrator's fingerprints consisting of a small count loop on the
sentences.zh: 警方从现场收集了少量的证据，包括肇事者的指纹，其特征是在

sentences.en: right hand index finger and a scarred right hand pinky.
sentences.zh: 右手食指上有一个小箕形纹，右手小指有疤痕。

sentences.en: These matched fingerprints recovered from the 1971 Donvale assault.
sentences.zh: 这些指纹与1971年唐维尔袭击案中提取的指纹相吻合。

sentences.en: Two years later, on Monday February 14 1977, another sexual assault was reported, this time roughly 55km south in the suburb of Chelsea Heights.
sentences.zh: 两年后的1977年2月14日星期一，又有一起性侵案被报案，这次是在大约55公里以南的切尔西海茨郊区。

sentences.en: The crime scene yielded the same distinctive fingerprints as the Donvale and the Greensboro attacks.
sentences.zh: 犯罪现场提取到了与唐维尔和格林斯伯勒袭击案相同的独特指纹。

sentences.en: Investigators were well aware they were dealing with a serial rapiSt. Between 1971 and 1979, there were 12 assaults, attempted rapes and rapes throughout Melbourne attributed
sentences.zh: 调查人员非常清楚他们面对的是一名连环强奸犯。在1971年至1979年期间，墨尔本发生了12起袭击、企图强奸和强奸案，这些案件都被归咎于

sentences.en: to an unknown attacker police had dubbed the Donvale Rapist, named after the location his spree had begun.
sentences.zh: 一名身份不明的袭击者，警方称他为“唐维尔强奸犯”，这个名字取自他开始作案的地点。

sentences.en: Many of the victims were married women who were either home alone or with their young children when the Donvale Rapist struck.
sentences.zh: 许多受害者都是已婚妇女，在唐维尔强奸犯下手时，她们要么独自在家，要么和幼小的孩子在一起。

sentences.en: He appeared to stalk his victims, waiting until he knew they were alone or vulnerable before launching an attack.
sentences.zh: 他似乎一直在尾随受害者，等确认她们独自一人或毫无防备时才发动袭击。

sentences.en: Police were certain he deliberately targeted young mothers in order to control his victims by threatening to harm their children.
sentences.zh: 警方确信他故意以年轻母亲为目标，通过威胁伤害她们的孩子来控制受害者。

sentences.en: Descriptions provided by survivors allowed for the creation of a composite sketch of the rapist which was circulated widely among the police and public.
sentences.zh: 幸存者提供的描述使得绘制该强奸犯的合成画像成为可能，并在警方和公众中广泛传阅。

sentences.en: The suspect was between the ages of 34 and 44, had a pasty fair complexion, stood between 5 foot 4 inches to 5 foot 10 inches
sentences.zh: 嫌疑人年龄在34至44岁之间，皮肤苍白白皙，身高在5英尺4英寸到5英尺10英寸

sentences.en: tall, and had sandy, light brown or reddish blonde hair with long bushy sideburns.
sentences.zh: 之间，留着沙黄色、浅棕色或微红的金色头发，并带有长而浓密的鬓角。

sentences.en: As more details came to light, police tasked a sculptor with creating a bust of the perpetrator, the first time a three-dimensional likeness was made of a wanted man in Australia.
sentences.zh: 随着更多细节的浮出水面，警方指派了一位雕塑家制作罪犯的半身像，这是澳大利亚首次为通缉犯制作三维模型。

sentences.en: Eight survivors and two witnesses from the most recent crimes helped design the sculpture, which took 45 hours to build.
sentences.zh: 来自最近几起案件的八名幸存者和两名目击者协助设计了这座雕塑，耗时45小时建成。

sentences.en: A hairdresser coloured and combed a wig, and a makeup artist added skin tones to the bust, which police nicknamed Boris.
sentences.zh: 一位发型师为假发染色并梳理，一位化妆师为半身像添加了肤色，警方给这个半身像起了一个绰号叫鲍里斯。

sentences.en: Boris was used to gain the public's assistance in identifying its real-life counterpart, who was described as having soft hands, being well-spoken, and often going barefoot.
sentences.zh: 鲍里斯被用来争取公众的协助，以识别其现实生活中的原型。据描述，此人手部柔软，谈吐文雅，而且经常赤脚。

sentences.en: A few survivors thought he had a slight accent that might have been Scottish or Northern English.
sentences.zh: 一些幸存者认为他带有轻微的口音，可能是苏格兰口音或英格兰北部口音。

sentences.en: Another descriptor that appeared in several survivors' statements was that their attacker had an offensive odour,
sentences.zh: 几位幸存者的陈述中出现的另一个特征是，她们的袭击者有一种刺鼻的气味，

sentences.en: described as a combination of strong cigarette smoke, body odour, bitumen, or diesel.
sentences.zh: 被描述为浓重的烟草味、体味、沥青或柴油味的混合物。

sentences.en: As such, a newspaper sub-editor dubbed the Unknown Rapist, Mr Stinky.
sentences.zh: 因此，一位报社副主编给这名身份不明的强奸犯取了个绰号叫“臭虫先生”。

sentences.en: In 1982, five individual sets of fingerprints associated with the state's most notorious unsolved crimes were prominently
sentences.zh: 1982年，维多利亚州警方指纹局的办公室里显眼地展示着五套独立的指纹，它们都与该州最臭名昭著的未侦破案件有关，

sentences.en: displayed in the office of the Victoria Police Fingerprint Bureau in the hope that staff would memorise and recognise them instantly.
sentences.zh: 希望工作人员能将它们牢记于心并一眼认出。

sentences.en: Among them were the fingerprints belonging to Mr Stinky.
sentences.zh: 其中包括属于“臭气先生”的指纹。

sentences.en: The Bureau had no computers, so the team of 67 men and women would spend every day sifting through hundreds of Polaroid photographs taken at crime scenes to find matching
sentences.zh: 当时指纹局还没有电脑，因此这个由67名男女组成的团队每天都要花大量时间，在一堆案发现场拍摄的宝丽来照片中筛选，

sentences.en: characteristics with prints on file.
sentences.zh: 寻找与档案中指纹相符的特征。

sentences.en: On Monday July 12, Sergeant Andrew Wall decided to examine some fingerprints from cold case files and came across the ones lifted from the top of the driver
sentences.zh: 1982年7月12日星期一，高级警探安德鲁·沃尔决定检查一些积压悬案中的指纹，偶然发现了16年前从加里·海伍德的FJ霍顿轿车司机侧车门顶端提取的指纹。

sentences.en: side door of Gary Haywood's FJ Holden sedan 16 years earlier.
sentences.zh: 16年前从加里·海伍德的FJ霍顿轿车司机侧车门顶端提取的指纹。

sentences.en: The prints, which were suspected to belong to Gary Haywood and Abina Medill's killer, showed impressions of an individual's right middle and ring fingers.
sentences.zh: 这组怀疑属于加里·海伍德和阿比娜·梅迪尔凶手的指纹，显示了一个人的右手中指和无名指的印痕。

sentences.en: They immediately appeared familiar to Sergeant Wall, who quickly realised they matched those belonging to Mr Stinky.
sentences.zh: 沃尔警探对这些指纹顿感熟悉，他很快意识到这些指纹与属于“臭气先生”的指纹相吻合。

sentences.en: Although this breakthrough didn't bring authorities any closer to identifying Mr Stinky, it offered them a new suspect in the double homicide.
sentences.zh: 尽管这一突破并未让当局更接近于查明“臭气先生”的身份，但它为这起双重谋杀案提供了一个新的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: On January 4 1983, the development saw the reward for information about the crime increase from $10,000 to $50,000.
sentences.zh: 1983年1月4日，这一进展使得该犯罪线索的悬赏金额从1万美元提高到了5万美元。

sentences.en: In May the following year, a new task force was formed to identify and apprehend Mr Stinky.
sentences.zh: 第二年5月，一个旨在识别并抓捕“臭气先生”的新专案组宣告成立。

sentences.en: Headquartered at the offices of the Victorian Police Academy in the Melbourne suburb of Glen Waverley, the team comprised of four detectives who were led
sentences.zh: 该团队总部设在墨尔本格伦韦弗利郊区的维多利亚警察学院办公室，由四名侦探组成，

sentences.en: by Detective Senior Sergeant Dennis Hanna.
sentences.zh: 由高级警探丹尼斯·汉纳领导。

sentences.en: Within two weeks, they added a 13th rape to the list of attacks attributed to Mr Stinky.
sentences.zh: 在两周内，他们将第13起强奸案也归入了“臭气先生”所作的袭击之列。

sentences.en: This most recent assault had occurred several weeks earlier and within a kilometre of the task force's base.
sentences.zh: 这起最新的袭击事件发生在几周前，且距离专案组基地不到一公里。

sentences.en: Given the perpetrator was still active, the team understood the urgency of their task.
sentences.zh: 鉴于作案者仍在活动，团队深感任务的紧迫性。

sentences.en: People who had crossed paths with the 13 survivors were examined in an effort to find a connection between them.
sentences.zh: 为了找到他们之间的联系，警方对曾与这13名幸存者有过交集的人员进行了排查。

sentences.en: A computer database was created of individuals who had been in Shepparton in the 1960s and Melbourne's eastern suburbs during
sentences.zh: 警方建立了一个计算机数据库，收录了20世纪60年代在谢帕顿以及70年代在墨尔本东郊活动过的人员名单，

sentences.en: the 1970s, with investigators planning to cross-check the extensive lists to see if there was any overlap between the categories.
sentences.zh: 调查人员计划通过交叉比对这些庞大的名单，看看不同类别之间是否存在任何重叠。

sentences.en: Details from other cases were also studied to uncover more potential victims or perpetrators.
sentences.zh: 他们还研究了其他案件的细节，以发掘更多潜在的受害者或作案者。

sentences.zh: 帕特向其他几名员工发出警示，店经理随即报警。

sentences.en: Several days later, at around 5pm on Thursday March 21, Raymond Edmonds' fingerprints were examined by a senior detective working late at Sydney's Central Fingerprint Bureau.
sentences.zh: 几天后的3月21日星期四下午5点左右，雷蒙德·埃德蒙兹的指纹被悉尼中央指纹局一名加班的高级侦探进行了检查。

sentences.zh: 食指指纹清晰可辨，而右手小指上则有一道伤疤横贯而过。

sentences.en: Raymond Edmonds was born in Melbourne on March 12, 1944.
sentences.zh: 雷蒙德·埃德蒙兹于1944年3月12日出生于墨尔本。

sentences.en: As his birth mother was young and unwed, Edmonds was adopted by a married couple named Harold and Mavis Edmonds, though he wouldn't learn of his adoption until his teenage years.
sentences.zh: 由于生母年轻且未婚，埃德蒙兹被一对名为哈罗德和玛维斯·埃德蒙兹的已婚夫妇收养，不过他直到青少年时期才知道自己是被收养的。

sentences.en: He was the couple's only child and they doted on him, leading some of the family's relatives to believe he was spoiled and undisciplined.
sentences.zh: 他是这对夫妇唯一的孩子，两人对他百般宠爱，这导致家族中的一些亲戚认为他被宠坏了，缺乏管教。

sentences.en: By the time Edmonds was six years old, he started exhibiting signs of being withdrawn and struggled to connect with others.
sentences.zh: 埃德蒙兹六岁时，便开始表现出性格孤僻的迹象，并且难以与他人建立联系。

sentences.en: Harold Edmonds was a businessman who bought and sold farms and his family often relocated to various towns throughout Victoria for his work.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德·埃德蒙兹是一名买卖农场的商人，为了工作，他的家人经常搬迁到维多利亚州的各个城镇。

sentences.en: In the mid-1950s, when Edmonds was 13 years old, the family made their sixth move since his adoption.
sentences.zh: 20世纪50年代中期，当埃德蒙兹13岁时，这家人经历了自他被收养以来的第六次搬家。

sentences.en: Around the same time, his father purchased him a gift, an automatic Mossberg
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，他的父亲给他买了一件礼物，一支带有折叠握把的莫斯伯格全自动

sentences.en: .22 rifle with a fold-down grip.
sentences.zh: .22口径步枪。

sentences.en: On one occasion, Mavis took her son to see a doctor for a diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 有一次，玛维斯带着儿子去看医生以寻求诊断。

sentences.en: The doctor found no physical cause for the problem, but noticed that Edmonds only had one testicle.
sentences.zh: 医生没有发现该问题的生理原因，但注意到埃德蒙兹只有一个睾丸。

sentences.en: He prescribed a drug to treat the issue, but later confessed to Mavis that he had prescribed the incorrect medication, one that was used to accelerate puberty.
sentences.zh: 他开了一种药来治疗这个问题，但后来向玛维斯坦白，说自己开错了药，开成了一种用于加速青春期发育的药物。

sentences.en: Mavis shared this information with friends, but little else is known about the matter as the doctor's records were not retained.
sentences.zh: 玛维斯将此事告诉了朋友，但由于医生的病历没有保存下来，关于这件事的其他情况人们知之甚少。

sentences.en: As a teenager, Edmonds didn't form any close friendships with other boys his age and was almost exclusively fixated on sex and young women.
sentences.zh: 青少年时期的埃德蒙兹没有和同龄男孩建立任何亲密友谊，几乎满脑子都想着性与年轻女性。

sentences.en: When he was 16 years old, he impregnated a girl who gave the child up for adoption.
sentences.zh: 16岁时，他使一名女孩怀孕，后者将孩子送作了领养。

sentences.en: At 17, Edmonds was seduced by an older woman who was a friend of his family.
sentences.zh: 17岁时，埃德蒙兹被一位身为他家庭朋友的年长女性勾引。

sentences.en: They participated in experimental and violent sex and she encouraged him to watch sex acts between herself and her girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 他们尝试了实验性和暴力的性行为，她还鼓励他观看她与女友之间的性行为。

sentences.zh: 南威尔士州交界处。

sentences.en: It was there that he met Leslie Crawford, a tall, blonde teenager two years his junior.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里，他遇到了莱斯利·克劳福德，一个比他小两岁的身材高挑的金发少女。

sentences.en: The pair had an on and off relationship until Leslie broke up with Edmonds towards the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 两人分分合合，直到那年年底莱斯利与埃德蒙兹分手。

sentences.zh: 几周后他们复合了，并在莱斯利16岁生日那天，两人孕育了一个孩子。

sentences.en: Leslie's parents disliked Edmonds and offered to support their daughter and her baby themselves.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利的父母不喜欢埃德蒙兹，并提出由他们自己来抚养女儿和她的孩子。

sentences.en: But Leslie chose to stay with her child's father, in the hopes they could have a happy life together.
sentences.zh: 但莱斯利选择和孩子父亲在一起，希望能和他过上幸福的生活。

sentences.en: The couple married in September of 1961 and moved to a dairy farm where Edmonds and his father worked.
sentences.zh: 两人于1961年9月结婚，并搬到一个乳牛场，埃德蒙兹和父亲在那里工作。

sentences.en: Edmonds was unfaithful to Leslie from the outset of their marriage, but was also extremely jealous of any attention she received.
sentences.zh: 埃德蒙兹从婚姻一开始就对莱斯利不忠，但同时也对她受到的任何关注极端嫉妒。

sentences.en: When their first child was born, he refused to visit his wife in hospital and she briefly returned to live with her parents.
sentences.zh: 在他们的第一个孩子出生时，他拒绝去医院看望妻子，妻子随后短暂搬回了娘家。

sentences.en: The couple reconciled again and soon had a second child.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇后来又复合了，不久便有了第二个孩子。

sentences.en: Edmonds had a violent temper that could erupt at any time and he often took his anger out on the animals he worked with.
sentences.zh: 埃德蒙兹脾气暴躁，随时可能发作，他经常把怒气发泄在他共事的动物身上。

sentences.en: He earned a reputation for animal cruelty after he almost beat a cow to death with an iron chain, an incident that deeply disturbed those who witnessed it.
sentences.zh: 他曾用铁链差点把一头母牛活活打死，这一事件深深震惊了目击者，他也因此落下了虐待动物的恶名。

sentences.zh: 作为报复，一名愤怒的同事猛扑向埃德蒙兹，用刀刺伤了他的手臂。

sentences.en: Leslie was also a victim of Edmonds' violence.

sentences.en: By the time Leslie was 19, she was pregnant with the couple's third child.

sentences.en: Leslie began to scream and her husband simply exited the room in silence.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利尖叫起来，而她的丈夫只是默默地走出了房间。

sentences.en: Like his father,
sentences.zh: 就像他的父亲一样，

sentences.zh: 埃德蒙兹从不在一个地方呆太久。

sentences.en: By 1966, Edmonds and Leslie lived with their three young children on a dairy farm in Ardmona, a rural area 10 kilometres west of Shepparton.
sentences.zh: 到1966年，埃德蒙兹和莱斯利带着三个幼小的孩子住在谢帕顿以西10公里处一个名为阿尔德莫纳的农村地区的乳牛场里。

sentences.zh: 埃德蒙兹外出过夜，没有回来。

sentences.zh: 到1968年，莱斯利已经对丈夫会改变这一奢望彻底死心了。

sentences.zh: 她搬回娘家居住，作为惩罚，埃德蒙兹拒绝让她与孩子们有任何接触，她有四年没有见到他们。

sentences.en: Several years later, Edmonds began a romantic relationship with his live-in housekeeper, Colleen, who had two children.

sentences.zh: 他正式与莱斯利离婚，并娶了科琳。

sentences.zh: 当侦探告知他因涉嫌1966年谋杀谢帕顿年轻夫妇一案而被拘留盘问时，他表现得很镇定。

sentences.en: When asked if he had been in Shepparton at the time, he evasively replied, I might and might not have been.
sentences.zh: 当被问及事发时是否去过谢帕顿，他 evasive（闪烁其词）地回答：“我可能去过，也可能没去过。”

sentences.zh: 他还否认自己对20世纪70年代发生在墨尔本的任何强奸案负责，但随着审讯的进行，他的自信开始动摇。
